scenariosToRun.description: ALL or a list of scenario codes to run

systemInfoParameters.description: Root-level system info parameters set as env vars

knownDeviations.description: #398: provider-level documented non-conformances declared in the wizard. A step whose HTTP status matches a documented deviation is reported as a passing 'known deviation' (WARNING) instead of a failure, so a clean run is not dragged to FAILED by an already-reported provider gap.

step.description: Request/step name, e.g. 'GET Passenger' or '04. GET Passenger' (the 'NN. ' prefix is optional).

expectedStatus.description: The documented HTTP status for this gap, e.g. 501.

note.description: Why it is accepted, e.g. 'GET /passengers not implemented (reported to ÖBB)'.

active.description: Checklist toggle — untick (false) to keep the deviation on record without enforcing it (e.g. after the provider fixes it). Defaults to true.

requestedInformationProbe.description: Negative-test probe for OSDM requestedInformation (#258 Phase 3c). 'off' (default): auto-provide demanded fields so the happy flow completes. 'omit': withhold required fields. 'invalid': send invalid values. With omit/invalid OSCAR asserts the provider rejects with a conformant RFC-9457 Problem.

bookingPurchaserMode.description: Where the purchaser is supplied for a booking (#258 / #203). 'inline' (default): the purchaser is sent in the POST /bookings request (historic behaviour). 'deferred': omit it at booking, then POST it to /bookings/{id}/purchaser afterwards (happy path — also exercises any purchaser requestedInformation the booking raised). 'omit': never supply the purchaser. 'invalid': omit at booking, then POST an invalid purchaser and assert an RFC-9457 Problem. 'invalid_at_booking' (#899): the purchaser in the booking, one field wrong per pass, each refusal graded, then the booking with the valid purchaser; the run's copy turns 'invalid' into it when the Test Framework says the provider takes no purchaser after the booking.

expiredBookingTest.description: Negative test for an EXPIRED booking (#204). When on, OSCAR waits until just past booking.confirmationTimeLimit, then attempts POST /fulfillments and asserts the provider REJECTS it (4xx + RFC-9457 Problem) and that the booking's admissions/reservations are EXPIRED/RELEASED/CANCELLED. If waiting until the deadline would exceed the run budget (RUN_TIMEOUT_MS), the test is skipped with a WARNING. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

expiredBookingMaxWaitMinutes.description: Per-scenario max wait budget for #204 expiredBookingTest, in MINUTES (1-60). When set AND expiredBookingTest is on, OSCAR uses this as the per-scenario wait budget instead of the server-wide RUN_TIMEOUT_MS, and the runner auto-extends the worker SIGTERM to cover it (clamped to the server-side RUN_HARD_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS cap, default 30 min). Leave null/empty to use the server default. Lets a tester opt into a longer wait (e.g. Bileto/Paxone deadlines ~15 min) without needing to also change the server env.

expiredOfferTest.description: Negative test for an EXPIRED offer (Phase 2 of the expired-flow generalization). When on, OSCAR waits until just past the earliest OfferPart.validUntil from the selected offer, then attempts POST /bookings and asserts the provider REJECTS it (4xx + RFC-9457 Problem) — an expired offer must not be bookable. If waiting until the deadline would exceed the run budget (RUN_TIMEOUT_MS / per-scenario expiredOfferMaxWaitMinutes), the test is skipped with a WARNING. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

expiredOfferMaxWaitMinutes.description: Per-scenario max wait budget for the expiredOfferTest, in MINUTES (1-60). When set AND expiredOfferTest is on, OSCAR uses this as the per-scenario wait budget instead of the server-wide RUN_TIMEOUT_MS, and the runner auto-extends the worker SIGTERM to cover it (clamped to the server-side RUN_HARD_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS cap, default 30 min). Leave null/empty to use the server default. Lets a tester opt into a longer wait when a provider's OfferPart.validUntil is far in the future.

expiredAddReservationOfferTest.description: Negative test for an EXPIRED post-booking add-reservation offer-part (Phase 5a of the expired-flow generalization). When on, OSCAR waits until just past the validUntil of the reservationOfferPart that 09. POST Add Reservation to Booking is about to send, then attempts the add and asserts the provider REJECTS it (4xx + RFC-9457 Problem). Skips with a WARNING if the wait would exceed the run budget. Only meaningful when salesFlow_placeSelection is on AND placeSelectionMode is ADD_TO_BOOKING (otherwise step 09 doesn't run). Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

expiredAddReservationOfferMaxWaitMinutes.description: Per-scenario max wait budget for the expiredAddReservationOfferTest, in MINUTES (1-60). Same auto-extend semantics as expiredOfferMaxWaitMinutes.

expiredAddAncillaryOfferTest.description: Negative test for an EXPIRED post-booking add-ancillary offer-part (Phase 5b of the expired-flow generalization). When on, OSCAR waits until just past the EARLIEST validUntil across the ancillary offer-parts that 10. POST Add Ancillary to Booking is about to send (sourced primarily from 11. additional-offers, falling back to the selected offer's own ancillaryOfferParts), then attempts the add and asserts the provider REJECTS it (4xx + RFC-9457 Problem). Skips with a WARNING if the wait would exceed the run budget. Only meaningful when salesFlow_addAncillary is on. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

expiredAddAncillaryOfferMaxWaitMinutes.description: Per-scenario max wait budget for the expiredAddAncillaryOfferTest, in MINUTES (1-60). Same auto-extend semantics as expiredOfferMaxWaitMinutes.

expiredRefundOfferTest.description: Negative test for an EXPIRED refund offer (Phase 3 of the expired-flow generalization). When on, OSCAR waits until just past the RefundOffer.validUntil of the first refund offer returned by 10. POST Refund Offers, then attempts 13. PATCH Refund Offer (CONFIRMED) and asserts the provider REJECTS it (4xx + RFC-9457 Problem). Skips with a WARNING if the wait would exceed the run budget. Only meaningful in REFUND-type scenarios. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

expiredRefundOfferMaxWaitMinutes.description: Per-scenario max wait budget for the expiredRefundOfferTest, in MINUTES (1-60). Same auto-extend semantics as expiredOfferMaxWaitMinutes.

expiredExchangeOfferTest.description: Negative test for an EXPIRED exchange offer (Phase 4 of the expired-flow generalization). When on, OSCAR waits until just past the ExchangeOffer.preBookableUntil of the first exchange offer returned by 10. POST Exchange Offers, then attempts 11. POST Exchange Operations and asserts the provider REJECTS it (4xx + RFC-9457 Problem). NOTE: the spec field on ExchangeOffer is `preBookableUntil`, NOT `validUntil` — see OSDM_Spec_Deviations #25 for the per-resource-type naming inconsistency. Skips with a WARNING if the wait would exceed the run budget. Only meaningful in EXCHANGE-type scenarios. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

expiredExchangeOfferMaxWaitMinutes.description: Per-scenario max wait budget for the expiredExchangeOfferTest, in MINUTES (1-60). Same auto-extend semantics as expiredOfferMaxWaitMinutes.

partialRefundByLeg.description: Per-leg partial refund scope (issue #218). When on, OSCAR scopes the refund to one leg of a multi-leg trip via OSDM's RefundSpecification.bookingPartIds. Requires a multi-leg trip — wizard blocks save when SPECIFICATION trip is single-leg; SEARCH-mode trips are checked at offer-runtime and the test degrades to full-refund with a [WARNING] when only one leg comes back. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

partialRefundLegSelection.description: Which leg to refund when partialRefundByLeg is on. 'first' / 'last' are valid for any multi-leg trip; 'outbound' / 'inbound' are only valid when the trip is a return-trip. Default 'first'.

partialRefundByPax.description: Per-passenger partial refund scope (issue #218). When on, OSCAR scopes the refund to one passenger of a multi-passenger booking via OSDM's RefundSpecification.passengerIds. Requires ≥2 passengers — wizard blocks save when the passengersList has only 1 entry. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

partialRefundPaxSelection.description: Which passenger to refund when partialRefundByPax is on. 'first' refunds passenger #1, 'last' refunds the last passenger, 'third' the last third of the passengers, rounded up (#699). Default 'first'.

partialRefundByFulfillment.description: #595: when on, the refund is that of one whole fulfillment: only fulfillmentIds is sent, no refundSpecifications. For providers that refund per fulfillment only. Requires the booking to have 2 fulfillments or more, else the run degrades to a full refund with a [WARNING]. Takes precedence over partialRefundByLeg / partialRefundByPax. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

partialRefundFulfillmentSelection.description: Which fulfillment to refund when partialRefundByFulfillment is on: 'first' / 'last' of the booking, or the one holding the 'outbound' / 'inbound' trip of a return. Default 'first'.

passengerExternalRefFormat.description: Non-happy-flow probe. When set to a printf-style pattern, OSCAR rewrites every passenger reference at scenario-parse time to use that pattern. The new ref propagates through every downstream call (offer, booking, refund, exchange). Empty / missing = no rewrite, wizard-default '00001', '00002', ... is used (every production provider accepts this). Examples: 'PAX%04d' -> 'PAX0001', 'ABC-%03d' -> 'ABC-001', '%d' -> '1' (no padding). The pattern must contain a %d or %0Nd placeholder; without one, the probe is ignored at runtime and a [WARNING] is logged. Designed to document provider variance — e.g. Paxone rejects 'PAX1'-style refs with a catch-all Schema validation error, while Bileto / Sqills / Turnit / Benerail accept any non-empty string per OSDM v3.8 spec.

expectedProduct.description: The product (tariff) the scenario expects (#598): a product code, matched exactly, or else words of the product's name (summary, then description), without case. The offer step keeps the offers that hold it and stops the scenario when none does; the fulfilled booking must hold it. Empty or null: the offer is chosen as before.

requestedSections.description: Fares (#903): the sections of the trip the provider prices, sent as OfferCollectionRequest.requestedSections. Each names a start and an end station, a UIC URN (urn:uic:stn:8500010) or a bare UIC code; the start is usually a border station. OSDM asks for a section whenever fares are asked for given trips. Empty or null: none is sent.

isPartOfInternationalTrip.description: Fares (#903): TripSpecification.isPartOfInternationalTrip, sent on a trip specification only. OSDM uses it for VAT; OSCAR asserts nothing from it. Empty or null: not sent.

desiredFareCluster.description: Fares (#903): the cluster of the fare offer to choose (CLUSTERING model). Empty or null: the first fare offer.

bookMode.description: Fares (#903, used from #906): book the fare offer (FARE) or a product offer (PRODUCT). Empty or null: FARE when fares are asked for.

simulatorFaults.description: Faults the OSDM simulator answers this scenario with (#833): a list of fault codes, or the same as text, "offer.price-below-parts, booking.passenger-dropped". The collection sends them in the header X-Simulator-Faults; a real provider ignores it. The codes are listed in the simulator's documentation. Empty or null: no fault.

legTravelClasses.description: The travel class expected on each leg of the trip, in the order of the legs (#600): a list such as ["FIRST", "SECOND"], or the same as text, "FIRST, SECOND". The offer request asks for every class named; the offer chosen gives each leg its class (by an admission of its own, or by a supplement on that leg), and the booking must give the same. Empty or null: the travel class criterion applies as before.

passengerUpdateScope.description: Which passengers step 03 updates after the booking (PATCH /bookings/{id}/passengers/{id}). ALL (default): every passenger. MAIN: the first passenger only, for providers that let only the main passenger be changed. Passengers not updated are read back at step 04 against the values the booking sent.

mandatoryReservationForm.description: How a mandatory reservation booked without a seat choice is sent (#793). PLACE_SELECTION (default): a placeSelection naming its trip and leg. NONE: it is named nowhere in the booking request, and the provider books it with the booking. A reservation with a seat choice (preferences, a named place, a reference place) always gets its placeSelection. The run's copy takes the Test Framework's value when the scenario names none.

reservationBookingForm.description: How the optional seat reservations are booked (#601). A mandatory reservation (a relation of an admission with minGroupItemsToBeBooked above 0) is always booked with the booking. RESERVATION_SELECTION: optionalReservationSelections; PLACE_SELECTION: placeSelections naming the trip and leg; ADD_LATER: added after the booking by POST /bookings/{id}/booked-offers/{id}/offer-parts. Empty or null: optional reservations are not booked.

refundReceiptMaxWaitMinutes.description: Refund receipt (#603). When set (1 to 60), after the refund the booking is read again every 15 seconds until a document of type INFORMATION appears in it (documents or fulfillmentDocuments), for up to this many minutes; none by then is a failure. The run's time limit grows by this wait. Empty or null: the receipt is not awaited.

idempotencyCheck.description: Idempotency-Key test (#604). When on, POST /bookings and POST /bookings/{id}/fulfillments carry an Idempotency-Key and are each sent again with the same key: the same booking, or the same fulfillments, must come back, and no second booking. The booking is also sent with another key, which must give a new booking (left pre-booked). Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

offersByTripIds.description: Offers asked by trip id (#602). When on, the offer step first asks POST /trips-collection with the origin, destination and time of the scenario's SEARCH trip, takes the trip running the trip's train (vehicleNumber) or, without one, the first leaving at the time asked or later, and asks POST /offers with tripIds naming it. A one-way journey only: a return, or a SPECIFICATION trip, is asked as before with a WARNING. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

tripIdsExpectRejection.description: Negative test (#602). When on, POST /offers names a trip id the provider never gave: it must answer 4xx with an RFC-9457 Problem, and the scenario ends there. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

refundAgainProbe.description: Negative test (#700). When on, once the refund is confirmed (14), POST /bookings/{id}/refund-offers is sent again for the refunded fulfillments and must be refused (4xx with an RFC-9457 Problem). Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

exchangeRefundedProbe.description: Negative test (#700). When on, once the refund is confirmed (14), POST /bookings/{id}/exchange-offers is sent for the refunded fulfillments and must be refused (4xx with an RFC-9457 Problem). Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

confirmAgainProbe.description: Negative test (#700). When on, once the booking is confirmed (06), POST /bookings/{id}/fulfillments is sent again without an Idempotency-Key: the same fulfillments, or a 4xx refusal; never new tickets. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

emptyPassengersExpectRejection.description: Negative test (#703). When on, POST /offers is sent with an empty anonymousPassengerSpecifications list, which OSDM does not allow (one or more): it must be refused with a 4xx RFC-9457 Problem, and the scenario ends there. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

departureDaysFromToday.description: The scenario's own departure date (#704), in days from the day of the run: 0 today, -1 yesterday, 90 in ninety days. It replaces the run's lead time and the trip's weekday. Used for the sales-horizon and past-departure tests. Between -366 and 1000; any other value is ignored.

expectedCurrency.description: The currency (ISO 4217) the offers must be in when the request asks for none: the provider's default currency (#781). The booking, the refund and the exchange are then checked against the currency of the sale.

currencyExpectRejection.description: Negative test (#781). When on, the offer search criteria ask for a currency the Test Framework does not declare: POST /offers must refuse it or give no offer; offers in that currency fail, offers in another currency pass with a warning. The scenario ends there. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

offerOptionExpectRejection.description: Negative test (#780 PR C). When on, the offer search criteria ask for an option value the Test Framework does not declare: POST /offers may refuse it, give no offer or say it ignored it (PARAMETER_NOT_SUPPORTED); offers keeping to the value fail, offers not keeping to it with nothing said pass with a warning. The scenario ends there. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

departureExpectRejection.description: Negative test (#704). When on, the departure date (departureDaysFromToday) is one the provider must not sell, in the past or beyond its sales horizon: POST /offers must refuse it with a 4xx RFC-9457 Problem, or give no offer. The scenario ends there. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

passengerLimitExpectRejection.description: Negative test (#699). When on, the scenario's passengers are one more than the provider's maximum (Test Framework maxPassengers): POST /offers must refuse them (4xx with an RFC-9457 Problem, or no offer), or else POST /bookings must (4xx). The scenario ends at the refusal. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

expectedProductAbsent.description: Negative test (#599). When true, no offer may hold expectedProduct (for example a group that the product's rules exclude): the offer step passes when none does, fails when one does, and the scenario ends there either way. Ignored without expectedProduct. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

offerSearchProbe.description: Offer search probe (#780). When on, the scenario tests its offer search criteria: after 01. POST Get Offer, an option it sends that no offer keeps to, or that the provider says it ignored, fails; the scenario ends there. The catalogue makes one such scenario per option value the Test Framework declares. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

overruleCodeExpectRejection.description: Negative test (#596). When on, the provider is expected to refuse overruleCode: 10. POST Refund Offers must answer 4xx with an RFC-9457 Problem, and the scenario ends there. Without an overruleCode the flag is ignored with a WARNING. Accepts boolean true/false or the strings 'on'/'off'.

returnOffsetDays.description: For return trips: number of days after outbound departure for the inbound trip.

returnModel.description: For return trips (#594): SEPARATE = the inbound call names the outbound offer (outwardOfferIds), both offers are booked; COMBINED = it names the outbound trip (outboundTripIds, OSDM 3.7+) and gets offers covering both directions. Empty = SEPARATE.

returnFulfillments.description: For return trips (#594): the number of fulfillments expected after confirmation. Empty = not checked.

salesFlowActions.description: Optional intermediate booking-flow actions to exercise (issue #107). Optional features default off in the runner.

placeSelectionFlow.description: The OSDM place selection flow the scenario exercises (#766), as the offer's reservation parts name it in supportedPlaceSelectionFlows. When absent it follows from the place fields: placeSelectionMode is a named place (MANUAL_PLACE_SELECTION_WITHOUT_FEE); accommodationSelection COUCHETTE or BERTH, reservationBookingForm PLACE_SELECTION, or placePreferences, is AUTOMATIC_PLACE_SELECTION. Checked against the Test Framework's placeSelectionFlows.

namedPlaceKind.description: In a manual place selection flow named by the scenario (placeSelectionFlow MANUAL_PLACE_SELECTION_WITHOUT_FEE or _WITH_FEE), what is named on the place map (#766): PLACE (default), a free seat per passenger, in placeSelections[].places; COMPARTMENT, a free compartment booked as a whole, in placeSelections[].compartments. POST /availabilities/vehicle-place-map is asked before the booking; the booking must give the places named, at the offer's price plus their selection fees.

referencePlace.description: In the AUTOMATIC_PLACE_SELECTION_NEARBY flow (#766), the place the passengers want to sit near, as coach / place: "7/15". GET /availabilities/nearby is asked for it before the booking, and the booking sends it in placeSelections[].referencePlace. A place given outside its coach is a warning; the reference place itself given to a passenger is a failure. Empty or "AUTO" (#776): the run books the trip first for the first passenger alone, takes the place given as the reference, and deletes that booking once the scenario's booking is answered.

placePreferences.description: Seat preferences asked in the booking (#766), as OSDM PlaceProperty codes: a list such as ["WINDOW"], or the same as text, "WINDOW, POWER". Only those the offer lists (availablePlacePreferences or availablePlaces) are sent, in placeSelections[].accommodations[].placeProperties; one it does not list is a warning. In the AUTOMATIC_PLACE_SELECTION_PREFERENCES flow GET /availabilities/preferences is asked first. A booked place without a preference asked is a warning. A scenario with preferences books its optional reservations by placeSelections unless it names another reservationBookingForm.

placeSelectionMode.description: How place selection is exercised (issue #107). SEATMAP_AT_OFFER = seat map before booking; ADD_TO_BOOKING = reservation added to an existing booking.

accommodationSelection.description: Type of accommodation to select during place selection. E.g. 'SEAT', 'COUCHETTE', 'BERTH', 'VEHICLE', 'COMPARTMENT'.

accommodationGenderPreference.description: Issue #211 — for gender-segregated night-train COUCHETTE/BERTH compartments, the desired availablePlaces.placeProperties value to select (and to assert echoed back in the booking response). Not a passenger-level field (see #227).

bookMandatoryReservations.description: Issue #239 — book the selected offer's reservationOfferParts via the booking request's optionalReservationSelections node ({reservationId} per part), the OSDM-defined mechanism for offers where a reservation is mandatory. Independent of placeSelections/accommodationSelection, which additionally state WHICH place/compartment is wanted; this only declares the reservation itself should be booked.

stepFailurePolicy.description: How the runner behaves when a step fails. 'CONTINUE': log the error and proceed; 'HARD_STOP': abort the scenario immediately.

description.description: Human-readable description of the scenario (e.g. possible trips).

shared.description: Whether the scenario is shared with the certifier.

created_by.description: Email of the user who created the scenario.

departureDay.description: Constrain departure to a specific day of week (for SEARCH trips).

origin.description: URN of the origin stop place.

destination.description: URN of the destination stop place.

endDatetime.description: Latest arrival datetime (ISO 8601, supports %TRIP_DATE% placeholder). Empty string means no constraint.

legs.description: For SPECIFICATION trips or multi-leg SEARCH trips: explicit leg definitions.

bornYearsBeforeTravel.description: The passenger's age on the day of travel, in whole years (#705): the date of birth is worked out from the departure day at each run and replaces dateOfBirth. 0 to 120.

bornDaysAfter.description: Days added to the date of birth that bornYearsBeforeTravel gives (#705): 1 = the birthday is tomorrow, so the passenger is still one year younger on the day of travel. -366 to 366.

expectedPassengerType.description: The passenger type the chosen offer must price the passenger as (#705), checked in appliedPassengerTypes: none given is a warning, another type a failure.

reductionCards.description: Reduction cards of the passenger (#597): codes from the provider's list (GET /reduction-cards), sent as CardReferences { type: REDUCTION_CARD, code, issuer } in the offer and booking requests. An entry may also be an object { code, issuer, number }.

category.description: Passenger category used for fare selection.
